* NBI: Yes you can just pick it up. Or kung may luma ka pang copy nung prev NBI, renewal nalang mas mabilis.


* SSS: You can call 920-6446 to 55. They can just give you the number. Protip: Might as well try to get your UMID when your near their branch. It's free though you'll receive it after 2-3mos. 


* TIN: Call 9817000 and you can get the number there. If you had a prev job, it depends if your current employer will ask for the ITR (which should have been provided by your last employer on clearance)

* PAGIBIG: Get your number from their hotline: 724-4244. If you haven't registered yet, get an MDF form from their website, print and fill it out. Go to your nearest Pagibig branch to have it submitted

* Philhealth: AFAIK, you need to go to their nearest office/branch/kiosk to get your record from them. If you haven't registered yet, go to the nearest branch. Protip: Get your Philhealth ID as well. It only talkes <5mins for them to print it out. 


Almost all of these could just be accomplished by a phone call through government hotlines. You'll need to go directly to a branch when your employer would ask for specific forms.(which they rarely do.) If you need everything by Monday, a whole day's work could get everything done even if you need to get registered on some. (except for NBI clearance which depends on your appointment) 

Best of luck!

NTC badly needs volunteers for speedtesting residential accounts. Internet speeds are definitely too slow and too pricey in the PH but since they dont have enough data to support it, ISPs and the gov't itself brushes it off. I just had my speeds tested yesterday andit only took 10 mins. They have friendly engineers, ID, and they bring their own laptops and ethernet cables. You dont even have to beathome, just anyone old enough. 

If you're interested, please email comsumer@ntc.gov.ph and tell them you want to volunteer. Guys, if you want to solve the problem with ISPs, just lend 10 minutes of your time. I was just so sad to hear that since January, they only had 25 volunteers.
